```artifact
Feature: Login Functionality

  Scenario Outline: Successful login with default credentials
    Given the system is up and running
    And the <user_type> has been set up with default password "<default_password>"
    When the <user_type> logs in with username "<username>" and password "<password>"
    Then the login should be successful
    And the user should be redirected to the dashboard

    Examples:
      | user_type | default_password | username | password |
      | Doctor    | Doctor123        | doctor1  | Doctor123  |
      | Chemist   | Chemist123       | chemist1 | Chemist123 |
      | Lab       | Lab123           | lab1     | Lab123     |

  Scenario Outline: Failed login with incorrect password
    Given the system is up and running
    And the <user_type> has been set up with default password "<default_password>"
    When the <user_type> logs in with username "<username>" and password "<incorrect_password>"
    Then the login should fail
    And an error message "<error_message>" should be displayed

    Examples:
      | user_type | default_password | username | incorrect_password | error_message |
      | Doctor    | Doctor123        | doctor1  | Doctor1234         | Invalid password |
      | Chemist   | Chemist123       | chemist1 | Chemist1234        | Invalid password |
      | Lab       | Lab123           | lab1     | Lab1234            | Invalid password |

  Scenario Outline: Failed login with non-existent username
    Given the system is up and running
    And the <user_type> has been set up with default password "<default_password>"
    When the <user_type> logs in with username "<non_existent_username>" and password "<default_password>"
    Then the login should fail
    And an error message "<error_message>" should be displayed

    Examples:
      | user_type | default_password | non_existent_username | error_message |
      | Doctor    | Doctor123        | doctor2               | User not found |
      | Chemist   | Chemist123       | chemist2              | User not found |
      | Lab       | Lab123           | lab2                  | User not found |
```
